Licensing & commercial terms

The intended offer.
The details still to come.

This page records the current plan. It is not a final licence agreement or an invitation to purchase.

What is established

A one-time Pro plan.

The intended Pro price is £35.99 once, with no trial and no recurring subscription. The planned licence covers this major version.

Scanning and individual cleanup are intended to remain free. Batch cleanup is planned as a Pro entitlement. Final enforcement and the live purchase flow still require verification.

The source includes Polar licence activation, validation and deactivation, with a local Keychain-backed record. A previously verified licence has a 30-day offline allowance in the current implementation. This describes code behaviour, not a completed service commitment.

See planned pricing ↗

Before checkout opens

Purchase conditions need approval.

  • The seller’s legal identity and contact details.
  • The number of Macs allowed per key and transfer arrangements.
  • Final tax presentation and the total payable.
  • Refund, cancellation and any statutory consumer-rights information.
  • Support and update commitments, including treatment of future major versions.
  • The final licence, governing terms and privacy policy.
No agreement is being accepted here.

There is no checkout or purchase submission on this website. Do not treat a development build, preview, roadmap item or draft price as a completed public product offer.

Names & materials

Respect the tools behind the work.

Developer-tool names and logos identify tools discussed by Cairn; their appearance does not imply endorsement or partnership.

The repository maintains third-party notices for bundled materials. A distributed app must include the notices applicable to the final packaged build.
